title: Brick Editor Build Script v1
description: Declarative build language compiled to LDraw parts (docs/AGENT-BUILDING.md). x/z in studs, y in plates ("4b" = 4 bricks); y = 0 is the ground; the front faces -Z.

palette.description: Named colours: {"wall": "white", "stone": {"mix": ["light bluish grey", "dark bluish grey"]}}

seed.description: Seed for colour mixes and scatter

size.description: [w, d]: its plot, from [0, 0] in its own frame; instance places this rectangle, so awnings, bays and ledges sticking out do not shift it (default: everything it holds)

ops.description: Ops in the component's own frame

colour.description: Palette key, colour name (e.g. 'light bluish grey') or LDraw code
Prefer parts made in this colour

when.description: Run only in component copies placed with this flag in `with` ('!flag': only without it)

colour.description: Colour: palette key, colour name or LDraw code

texture.description: Textured 1 × 2 bricks instead of plain ones: masonry (98283), log (30136) or grille (2877); plain bricks where the colour lacks them

pattern.description: With a {mix} colour: mix picks per piece (default); courses lays the colours course by course (a brick course = 3 plates), for stripes and bands

interior.description: Unseen inside: empty (hollow shell), fill (cheap large bricks in the interior colour) or solid

thickness.description: Shell wall thickness in studs when hollow

open.description: Faces of a hollow shell to leave out

top.description: Top surface: studs (default) or smooth tiles

pieces.description: auto: bricks where 3 plates fit, else plates

quoins.description: Corner blocks in this colour, interlocking course by course (2 studs along one face, 1 along the other)

supports.description: Hollow boxes: a 2 × 2 pier every this many studs (at least 4) under the lid of a wide shell

then.description: Rectangular volume packed into bricks/plates (greedy, staggered joints)
